recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Treat FHIR-3292 as superseded by the later Alert.note CodeableConcept decisions; do not add a parallel Flag.note or make Flag.code optional without a new applied/published tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-3292 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care request to change Alert.note from 1..1 to 0..1, add 0..1 Alert.code CodeableConcept, require at least note or code, and add guidance on code versus original text.
initial_application: No current source change remains that exactly implements separate optional note and code elements. The source trail shows #3523 first changed Alert.note itself to CodeableConcept while retaining 1..1, and db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 later cited {#3292} while renaming Alert.note to Flag.code and keeping a 1..1 CodeableConcept.
additional_context: FHIR-3523 and FHIR-3877 are later same-family Published decisions that converged on one required CodeableConcept rather than separate note/code elements. Flag is the active resource, Alert is removed, and later FHIR-8560/FHIR-11202 refinements confirm the current Flag.code binding and coded/textual wording. Community searches found no relevant conflict; the only Confluence refs hit for FHIR-3292 was an unrelated page where the string appeared as a prefix of other Jira keys.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Recreating the literal early FHIR-3292 shape would reverse later final decisions by adding separate note/code elements and weakening the required Flag.code model.
